text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? What, what?! What was that just now?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Somehow... I feel power welling up 
inside me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Deep in my chest, it's burning—! Right 
now, I want to run so, so badly...!
